name: Hudson Senior Center
schedule_note: Bingo days come from the group's own pages. Days and times can change, so call before you go.
notes: Slider card sales start at 1:10 p.m.; games start by 1:30 p.m. Cards are $1.25; the Shotgun Coverall is 50 cents.
